clue.text: Registered refusal to make hay

parts.note: a refusal is a plain no
to ted is to spread out mown grass to dry, the work of haymaking

explanation.surface: Someone records a refusal to help with the haymaking.
explanation.walkthrough: TED is a farming verb: to turn and spread grass so it dries into hay.
explanation.definitionFit: Something registered has been taken notice of and written down, a synonym in the sense of recorded.

clue.text: Lucky escape from the girl next door

parts.note: next door means close by, near
a girl may be addressed as miss

explanation.surface: Someone narrowly escapes the attentions of the young woman living next door.
explanation.definitionFit: A close call where disaster is only just avoided is a fortunate escape.

clue.text: Motorists' warning to pedestrians in London

definitions.meaning: drivers sound the horn to warn people walking
a district of south London, on the Northern line

explanation.surface: A London driver honks at people crossing the road.
explanation.walkthrough: TOOTING is a district in south London.
explanation.definitionFit: Hooting a car horn is a driver's warning; the London district shares the name.

clue.text: Murder a Spanish nobleman without one

indicators.note: without in its old sense of outside, so the nobleman's title goes round the other piece

parts.note: Don is the title of a Spanish gentleman
the Roman numeral for one is I

explanation.surface: Someone kills a Spanish grandee while alone.
explanation.walkthrough: 'without' looks like 'lacking' but means outside: DON goes round I.
explanation.definitionFit: To do someone in is a slang idiom for killing them.

clue.text: Brisk beating

definitions.meaning: a ... pace is a lively, quick one
a smacking given as punishment

explanation.surface: A quick, sharp thrashing.
explanation.definitionFit: A spanking pace is lively, and a spanking is a smacked bottom given as punishment.

clue.text: His CO may order: "Deliver to Paris"

definitions.text: His CO may order: "Deliver to Paris"

indicators.note: to order things is to arrange them, so the quoted words are put in a new arrangement

explanation.surface: A commanding officer issues a dispatch order to the French capital.
explanation.walkthrough: The commanding officer's 'order' is the anagram signal; the whole clue also describes a soldier of the lowest rank taking orders.
explanation.definitionFit: A soldier of the lowest rank is one whose commanding officer gives him his orders.

clue.text: Orderly way to serve the hard stuff

definitions.meaning: tidy and in good order

definitions.text: way to serve the hard stuff
definitions.meaning: spirits served undiluted, without ice or water

explanation.surface: A tidy barman knows how to pour whisky.
explanation.definitionFit: Neat means tidy, and spirits served straight with no mixer are served that way.

clue.text: Stylish, soft fabric is stylish

annotationWithheld.why: Clue held as 'Stylish, soft fabric is stylish': IN + P + LACE builds the answer, but 'stylish' repeated cannot define a phrase meaning positioned or fitting, so the final word looks misread and the printed definition is unknown.

clue.text: Manage to live harmoniously

definitions.meaning: to cope or make progress
to have a friendly relationship

explanation.surface: Someone manages to live in harmony with others.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrasal verb means both to cope and to be on friendly terms with someone.

clue.text: Good for you, the house is clearly haunted!

definitions.meaning: an exclamation of encouragement
read literally, a ghost is plainly present

explanation.surface: A cheery congratulation turns into a ghost-story verdict on the house.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase is an encouraging exclamation, and read literally says a ghost is there.

clue.text: Boil has to be treated to put an end to it

indicators.note: a boil being medically treated suggests these letters are worked on and rearranged

explanation.surface: A boil needs treatment to get rid of it.
explanation.definitionFit: To end a practice or law officially is to do away with it.

clue.text: Having trouble getting a piston replaced

indicators.note: replaced in the sense of placed differently, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A car is in trouble and needs a new piston.
explanation.definitionFit: Being in a spot is an idiom for being in a difficult situation.

clue.text: Pronouncement made by a servant

indicators.note: a pronouncement is something spoken, so the next word is heard rather than read

parts.note: these words are said aloud, and what is heard is the sound this part of the answer needs

explanation.surface: A domestic servant makes an announcement.
explanation.definitionFit: A female domestic servant is a housemaid.

clue.text: Way to rebuke and administer corporal punishment

parts.note: St is the abbreviation for street, a way
a rap is a sharp reprimand, as in a rap over the knuckles

explanation.surface: A stern way of scolding and physically punishing a child.
explanation.definitionFit: To beat someone with a leather belt is to give them corporal punishment.

clue.text: Useless to be cocky

definitions.meaning: to no purpose
conceited about oneself

explanation.surface: It does no good to be arrogant.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means both futile and conceited, two unrelated senses.

clue.text: He gives the same number to Regina

parts.note: do is short for ditto, meaning the same
R stands for Regina, Latin for queen, as in royal cyphers

explanation.surface: Someone offers the same figure to the Queen.
explanation.definitionFit: A giver, for instance of blood or money, is one who gives.

clue.text: Simpleton leaves a pub in New York

indicators.note: one piece is placed inside the abbreviation for New York

parts.note: an inn is a public house

explanation.surface: A fool walks out of a New York bar.
explanation.definitionFit: A foolish, silly person is a simpleton.

clue.text: A paper's emblem is indicative of today

definitions.meaning: the badge of a newspaper, The Times
something typical of the present age

explanation.surface: A newspaper's crest is a sign of modern life.
explanation.definitionFit: A phenomenon typical of current conditions is a symptom of the age.

clue.text: Repaired pine desk with just a lovely surface

indicators.note: a desk being repaired is put back together, so its letters are reassembled

explanation.surface: A mended pine desk looks good only on the outside.
explanation.definitionFit: Beauty that is only superficial goes no deeper than the outside layer.

clue.text: Recover personal-property and settle scores

definitions.meaning: literally, regain what belongs to you
take revenge

explanation.surface: Someone retrieves their belongings and takes revenge.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means to take revenge, and read literally it means retrieving your belongings.

clue.text: In retrospect no single story gave much pleasure

indicators.note: looking back, so the run of pieces is read from end to start

parts.note: taken as written
I, the Roman numeral one, is single
a tale is a story

explanation.surface: Looking back, not one story brought much joy.
explanation.walkthrough: 'In retrospect' turns NOITALE (NO, I, TALE) backwards.
explanation.definitionFit: Great happiness and exhilaration is a large amount of pleasure.

clue.text: One flower shaped like a needle

parts.note: an ace is a one in cards
a rose is a flower

explanation.surface: A single bloom with needle-like petals.
explanation.walkthrough: ACEROSE is a botanical term for leaves like pine needles.
explanation.definitionFit: The botanical term describes slender, pointed leaves resembling a needle.

clue.text: Outline a scheme

definitions.meaning: a diagram or drawing of a layout
a scheme is an intended course of action

explanation.surface: Sketch out a scheme.
explanation.definitionFit: A plan is both a drawing of a layout and a proposed method of doing something.

clue.text: Scratched the ground while Dad tied the knot

parts.note: Pa is an informal word for dad
to tie the knot is to marry, so wed

explanation.surface: A child fidgets with a foot while their father gets married.
explanation.definitionFit: A horse that scrapes at the ground with a hoof has done so with its paw.

clue.text: Common vegetables used to make Sunday desserts

parts.note: puds is British slang for puddings, meaning desserts

explanation.surface: Potatoes are somehow turned into a Sunday pudding.
explanation.walkthrough: SPUDS is informal British English for potatoes; PUDS is short for puddings, the British word for desserts.
explanation.definitionFit: Potatoes are an everyday vegetable, informally called by this name.

clue.text: Eager to acquire knowledge about the Orient

indicators.note: about means surrounding, so the word for knowledge goes round the other piece

parts.note: ken is one's range of knowledge
E stands for east, the Orient

explanation.surface: Someone eager to learn about the Far East.
explanation.definitionFit: Being keen means being enthusiastic and eager.

clue.text: Fancy man pursues wife

indicators.note: pursues means follows behind, so the man is placed after the wife

parts.note: him is a word for a man

explanation.surface: A lover chases a married woman.
explanation.definitionFit: A whim is a sudden fancy or impulse.

clue.text: Man's house may be entered by them

definitions.text: Man's house may be entered by them

parts.words: Man's house may be entered by them
parts.note: the lower house of the Isle of Man parliament bears this name, and house doors are opened with these

explanation.surface: Someone lets themselves into a man's home.
explanation.walkthrough: The House of Keys is the elected chamber of the Isle of Man's parliament.
explanation.definitionFit: Front doors are unlocked with them, and the Manx parliament's lower chamber is named after them.

clue.text: Where to find a woman after Pentecost?

indicators.note: the woman is placed after the festival

parts.note: Whit, or Whitsun, is the Christian feast of Pentecost
her refers to a woman

explanation.surface: Someone wonders where to meet a woman once Whitsun is over.
explanation.definitionFit: The old word asks to what place, the same as where to.

clue.text: Regards mineral deposit as a blemish

parts.note: eyes means looks at, regards
ore is a mineral deposit mined for metal

explanation.surface: Someone views a mining deposit as a scar on the landscape.
explanation.definitionFit: Something ugly that spoils a view is an unsightly blemish.

clue.text: I may tend to become explosive

indicators.note: the words turn into something else, so their letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone warns they could become volatile.
explanation.definitionFit: Nobel's blasting compound is a high explosive.

clue.text: Brush up on the lottery

definitions.meaning: to brush a floor
a ..., or sweepstake, is a lottery on a race

explanation.surface: Someone tidies up while reading about the lottery.
explanation.definitionFit: A sweep is a broom stroke and also a sweepstake, a draw for prize money.
